contracts.claim: The production local-pack generator builds all declared local-component packages in owned scratch; opened descriptors, manifests, file bytes and entrypoint source confirm package meaning, integrity, and portable paths; an out-of-scope source path is refused without writing outside scratch.
Catalog preserves every package tier and delivery state with exact current core/optional totals.
Plan resolves profile inheritance, optional exclusions and ordered dependency closure; unfinished packages block readiness and execution remains disabled.
Registry rejects package or profile dependency cycles before constructing a selectable registry.
Service declaration requires explicit loopback HTTP URLs, SHA256 pins, nonempty argv; environment content and inheritance participate in specification identity.
Every start validates executable and required-file SHA256 hashes before process creation or reuse.
Running status requires live PID, matching executable and specification, and endpoint health/identity. Foreign or changed identity cannot be stopped.
An installed exact healthy process is reused without spawning; an owned new process persists running identity and stops to a zero-PID state.
OpenClaw supports Node22 from22.22.3, Node24 from24.15.0 and Node25 from25.9.0 or later; Node23 and None are excluded.
Resolved Node directory leads PATH and NEYVIA_MANAGED_NODE_BIN; preserve original PATH suffix and other variables without mutating caller environment.
Pinned executable receipts reflect actual streamed SHA256 bytes; platform-managed entries stay distinct and aggregate invalidTools/healthy exactly match rows.

Stable release discovery binds exact asset template, bounded positive size, official GitHub repository URL and SHA256 digest; absence of digest raises before a candidate is returned; summary and signed-release activation policy match all rows.
Published discovery persists exact returned metadata; a fresh schema-compatible cache returns the same rows with cache=hit before any official release fetch.
Local add-on import closures include transitive module dependencies with unique portable sorted paths

The first-run base-pack flow stages the generated local component bytes under the selected state root, reports and consumes pause while preserving resumable bytes, resumes to an exact durable receipt, and refuses an unsafe manifest path without changing staged bytes.
Both Ed25519 signatures bind the observed manifest bytes, signing identity and trusted comment
Release output remains a fresh directory inside the selected repository target; in-tree private key paths are rejected before reading
Actual artifacts and staged files determine missing-artifact, size, shell-only and forbidden-content failures
Every current external registry pack retains pinned official source inputs, summed sizes and explicit activation blockers
Every Vite config evaluation uses the selected checkout physical web root, source alias and build output path
